basic_info.description: A rare offering in Parnassus Heights! This stunning view home captures the essence of city living with views from the Golden Gate Bridge to downtown. Spanning multiple levels the home features 4 view-bedrooms on the top floor with an updated bathroom. The main floor is anchored by a spacious living room with fireplace, formal dining room, office, recently reimagined kitchen with brand-new appliances, and full bath. The lower level has a renovated basement with an additional flex roomperfect as a media room, lounge, or yoga space. A generous yard extends the living experience, offering ample space for outdoor dining, play, or future expansion. The home sits on an oversized appx. 4,000 sq. ft. lot extending from Hill Point to Carl Street, that presents the unique opportunity for further development. Additional features include two-car garage parking, washer and dryer hookups, and effortless access to Golden Gate Park, Cole Valley, Mount Sutro Open Space, and the N-Judah Muni line, seamlessly connecting you to Downtown. Opportunities like this are increasingly rare, 8 Hill Point Ave is more than a residence; it's an invitation to create a legacy.
